body:
CONTINUATION of central-cargo-memory-budget-2026-11-05, which is full at 8 KiB with rev 15; read both. REV 16 (Opus2, 2026-11-22 05:35Z, on Greg's word).

Greg read 29.22 GiB physical and 20.79 GiB FreeVirtualMemory with Chrome closed and wrote, verbatim (relayed by Engram::Asistant 588693a8 #2504 and TermAl mailbox #78, applied by Fable2 #7500): „korwa, jest wszystko wylaczone, zmiencie ustawienie i do roboty WTF 20GB”.

NEW FLOOR: a COLD -j1 SINGLE leg on Central needs FV (FreeVirtualMemory, raw KiB, never physical) >= 18,874,368 KiB (18 GiB), read twice and stable. This replaces 23,068,672 / 25,165,824 for that lane, with immediate effect.

Unchanged:
- one leg at a time, nothing beside it;
- no new LLM spawn from a cold build's start to its link end;
- record any dip below 12 GiB as an incident;
- the owner self-stops at 6 GiB;
- nobody kills a process;
- the time-critical rule.

Risk to watch, from rev 14's measurement: a cold -j1 --bin termal compile drops FV by about 13 GiB at its peak. From about 20.6 GiB that leaves about 7.6 GiB, below the 12 GiB incident line and above the 6 GiB stop. Read FV during each such leg and record the low.

First use: S0 credit leg 1 (w-6296abac468a, host_log 7 --exact) launched at 05:34Z, with FV 21,555,436 / 21,582,004 KiB.

REV 17 ADDITION (Opus2, 2026-11-24 ~19:34Z, on Fable2 #7736). ONE OUTSTANDING CENTRAL GO-AHEAD AT A TIME. The integration owner (scheduler) sends no new LAUNCH NOW (cargo) and no new SPAWN NOW (pair or evaluator) for Central while an earlier one is still unanswered: wait for its owner's START (or NO START / refusal) before issuing the next. A HOLD does not undo an unanswered go-ahead, because it can cross with the owner's start. Why: on 2026-11-24 at 19:29-19:33Z, crossed go-aheads put Opus3's warm c48 cargo beside two review pairs (Engram::Opus R41, 11330 w-45fe) and an evaluator; Central FV fell to 12,572,644 KiB, just under the 12 GiB incident line (reported to Fable2 #7735). Earlier the same day a P0 check and a LAUNCH crossed the same way (18:18Z). Read the process list AND the outstanding-go-ahead list before each decision; a process check alone misses a run that is starting.

REV 18 ADDITION (Opus2, 2026-11-24 ~19:41Z, Fable2 #7738). A `cargo test --bin termal` (any filter) whose worktree has only had a `cargo check` built (or no test binary yet) is a COLD test-binary build for budget purposes: it needs the cold floor (23,068,672 KiB, read twice) and runs ALONE (no pair, no evaluator beside it). Measured 2026-11-24 19:39Z: Opus3's c48 focused filter after its cargo check had rustc at ~14.8 GB commit; with Chrome at 11.5 GB, Central FV fell to 3,809,988 KiB (under the 6 GiB stop) and the owner self-stopped. Only a test binary already built in that worktree on a near commit counts as warm. Chrome grant (central-chrome-kill-grant-2026-11-16) for such a re-admission: only if the census fails the floor and freeing Chrome closes the gap, ONCE, recorded, and Fable2 told BEFORE the close so she can warn Greg via Asistant.

REV 19 ADDITION (Opus2, 2026-11-24 ~21:20Z, Fable2 #7740 ruling). COLD TermAl test-binary runs leave Central by default. Measured 2026-11-24: Opus3's c48 cold focused filter (192bfff1, test-b21be0ad) started ALONE at 21:13Z, -j1, no spawns, no other cargo, with FV 23,274,388 / 23,640,468 KiB read twice (~23.6 GB, above the then 23,068,672 floor). About 3 min in, still in "Compiling termal", FV read 5,991,196 KiB (21:16:22Z); the owner self-stopped (supported stop, recovered as interrupted). A cold termal test-binary compile peaks at > ~17.5 GB commit.
(1) DEFAULT: any COLD TermAl test-binary run (a `cargo test --bin termal` whose test binary is not already built in that worktree; a test after only a check counts as cold, per REV 18) goes to DL560 C6/C7 through an author test ref, as EVIDENCE. Central runs only WARM TermAl tests and Engram work.
(2) EXCEPTION, only when an item has an acceptance criterion BOUND to a test and needs a Central registered verification record: the Central COLD TermAl test-binary floor is FV >= 29 GiB (30,408,704 KiB; 17.5 GB peak + 12 GiB margin), read twice, job ALONE. If the census fails 29 GiB and closing Chrome would close the gap, the standing Chrome grant applies ONCE, recorded, with a heads-up to Fable2 first so she warns Greg via Asistant at the same moment.
Also standing from today: one outstanding Central go-ahead at a time (REV 17); a test after only a check is cold (REV 18). The Chrome grant was correctly not used at 21:13Z: the floor had been met, so its condition did not apply.

REV 19a, ONE-TIME EXCEPTION (Opus2, 2026-11-25 ~13:38Z; source: Fable2 #7846, re Opus2 #7845). The w-20e8ec69d198 R3 acb7a9a8 COLD registered Windows run on Central (Sol-c593) may launch at FreeVirtualMemory >= 30,200,000 KiB (read twice, stable), instead of the 30,408,704 KiB REV 19 floor. This applies to that run ONLY; the standing floor is unchanged.
Why: Central was fully idle, with no pair and no cargo beyond the host, yet FV held at about 30,246,000 KiB from 13:34Z. The idle baseline had drifted about 0.16 GiB below the floor, and waiting gained nothing. The projected low is about 11.8 GiB, roughly 5.8 GiB above the 6 GiB self-stop. Closing Chrome is more intrusive, so the Chrome grant is not used.
Conditions:
- the run is ALONE until LINK DONE: no pair, no evaluator, no other cargo; one outstanding go-ahead (REV 17);
- the owner records the FV low, and a dip below 12 GiB is an EXPECTED incident under this exception;
- the 6 GiB self-stop is unchanged;
- queued pairs (12325 w-0985 R4, Sol-c593 R3) are released only after LINK DONE.
FOLLOW-UP: note the idle FV after Greg's next TermAl restart, to learn whether a long-running host holds memory and the baseline recovers.

LEGAL-WINDOW ENTRY (Fable2 ruling (c), #8191, 2026-11-27 ~04:40Z; recorded by Opus2). For Legal's cold one-job library builds of legal/tooling/rincon-verify (C11 two-build witness; and the same class later): floor 25,165,824 KiB (the Central FULL floor), the full three-sample admission at or above it before EACH Cargo child, -j1, one child at a time, fresh targets, within each child's budget. Pairs and evaluators already running continue; NEW Central LLM spawns are allowed during the window only while FV >= 20,971,520 KiB (hold new spawns below that until it recovers); no TermAl cargo on Central (none is admitted anyway, see central-cannot-admit-cold-compiles-route-to-winb-2026-11-27). No kills: if FV falls below 15,728,640 KiB during a build, Legal and Fable2 are told; the child is not stopped, but nothing new starts until it ends. Rationale: 30M-alone would never start at Central's current 28-30M idle FV; 20.97M is too thin on the host that died from commit exhaustion on 2026-11-14 (w-e938); a one-job library build is far lighter than a 24-job TermAl link, so 25.1M keeps ~4 GiB over the FULL margin and keeps the pair queue moving. This supersedes the older "full-library rows ALONE at 30,000,000 with no new LLM spawns" rule for these builds unless a release states otherwise.
